decisions.scope: Inherited @app/app-block-slot declarations across the ten themes
decisions.decision: Third-party activation is out of scope and forbidden; preserve dormant seam. Inventory it, mark activation CONSTITUTIONALLY_EXCLUDED with exact authority and reviewer reference, and require safe restriction/no execution/no misleading active editor-control acceptance. First-party sections and blocks remain fully required.
decisions.reason: The owner requested the ten first-party themes; they did not authorize reopening constitutionally frozen third-party execution.

decisions.decision: Keep full heading-customization requirement OPEN. Proposed fallback changes only missing-title rendering; it does not make the declared heading control effective on a real titled collection.
decisions.next: Prepare minimal versioned semantics where a deliberate heading edit affects intended real-collection output, preserving default visuals and immutable2.0.0. No Main edit/lease granted.

decisions.scope: MadeYours promised inline configured-cart editing versus remove/re-review alternative
decisions.decision: OPEN_DESIGN_CONTRACT_RECONCILIATION. Retain the approved design promise and exact earlier owner acceptance/amendment source. An agent-authored execution amendment alone cannot remove a promised control.
decisions.next: Show direct human acceptance if previously changed; otherwise propose compatible use of existing canonical configuration/review flow and preserve original line until acknowledgement. Do not auto-N/A the feature.

caseAccountingRule: Preserve exact original case IDs and original controller/reviewer status. Stricter derived all-clauses counters may coexist only if explicitly labelled and traceable; never erase historical PARTIAL into an unqualified NOT_RUN summary.
